apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

vessel-record.eventDescription: One OFAC SDN sanctioned-vessel record delivered to the dataset.

debarment-record.eventDescription: One World Bank "Other Sanctions" record delivered to the dataset.

statement-new.eventDescription: A UK Modern Slavery Statement Registry statement never delivered before.

statement-updated.eventDescription: A previously delivered UK statement whose content changed, or one re-sent unchanged by a full-snapshot run.

enforcement-release.eventDescription: A SEC litigation release or administrative proceeding not delivered before.

enforcement-update.eventDescription: A previously delivered SEC release whose content changed, or one re-sent unchanged by a full-snapshot run.

crawler-signal.eventDescription: A domain's AI-crawler permission and Content-Signal state delivered for the first time.

crawler-signal-change.eventDescription: A previously delivered domain whose crawler permissions, Content-Signal or llms.txt changed, or one re-sent unchanged by a full-snapshot run.

recall-record.eventDescription: One FDA enforcement or EMA safety record delivered to the dataset.

watchlist-hit.eventDescription: Charged once for each delivered regulatory record whose text matches a keyword of the caller's own watchlist. Never charged when no valid keyword was supplied.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Consolidation of single-source Actors into global-regtech-compliance-feed: each legacy source keeps its own per-record price as a separate event, and the start event is set to $0.005.
